asset_heavy.reason: Owns thousands of miles of fiber, copper, coaxial, wireless towers and spectrum; ongoing network construction expansion.

big_ticket.reason: Monthly broadband, voice and video subscriptions are small, frequent payments.

cyclical_demand.reason: Broadband, voice and 911 services are essential utility-like services that customers rarely cut in downturns.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are rural residential households and small local businesses; wholesale carriers are secondary.

notes: Fiber construction projects (Cal-Ore) are a minor side activity. Not a heavy reliance on any one source.

offers_products.reason: Revenue comes from connectivity services; any equipment is incidental to subscriptions.

offers_services.reason: Provides broadband, voice, video, wholesale network access, hosted/managed services and 911 services as a telecom carrier.

people_delivered.reason: Service depends on its fiber, wireless and copper networks rather than staff time.

recurring_revenue.reason: Subscription broadband, voice and video plus regulated federal support and wholesale access generate ongoing monthly revenue.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Provides broadband, voice and cable TV to residential customers in rural markets.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Serves business customers with enterprise, hosted and private line services, and sells wholesale network access to carriers.
